title: Environmental Code of the Republic of Kazakhstan (Экологический кодекс Республики Казахстан), whole Code; Chapter 20, arts. 281 to 304, state regulation of greenhouse gas emissions and removals
citation: Code of the Republic of Kazakhstan of 2 January 2021 No. 400-VI ZRK
evidence: Art. 416 para. 1: "Настоящий Кодекс вводится в действие с 1 июля 2021 года, за исключением случаев, предусмотренных статьей 418 настоящего Кодекса." Art. 418 (transitional provisions) lists no exception for Chapter 20. Metadata of the page: adopted 2 January 2021, published in the Эталонный контрольный банк НПА РК 08.01.2021, "Егемен Қазақстан" 05.01.2021 № 2, "Казахстанская правда" 05.01.2021 № 2. Opened https://adilet.zan.kz/api/documents/by-ngr/K2100000400?language=rus on 2026-11-02 (the page https://adilet.zan.kz/rus/docs/K2100000400 renders from it).
notes: Records stored on 2026-11-02 under KZ-ADILET-ADOPTED and KZ-ADILET-CONSOLIDATED: 46 Russian (ru, 2021-07-01 to 2026-09-08) and 47 Kazakh (kk, 2021-07-01 to 2026-09-08), both official languages the publisher serves; the 1 adopted record per language is dated the commencement date and the rest are Adilet's point-in-time editions, dated by the date Adilet gives for the edition. Whole Code as one instrument. Chapter 20 (Глава 20, arts. 281 to 304: greenhouse gases, national contributions, carbon budget, operator of the carbon unit trading system, carbon quotas, national carbon quota plan, monitoring and inventory of quota installations, carbon offset, carbon units and market, state register, administered installations, state inventory system, state carbon cadastre, validation and verification) is the F3 core; the register row also names F2 for the climate-policy articles of the Code, but the scope family is F3; the other chapters (environmental permits, impact assessment, ozone layer and others) are stored with it and are not separately registered. The Code has 69 version ids on Adilet in Russian and 52 in Kazakh; the Russian text on 2026-11-02 runs from the Adilet edition of 2021-01-02 (adopted) to the edition of 2026-09-08. Edition dates in Russian and Kazakh agree except 2026-08-25, which only the Kazakh list has. The edition of 2025-03-16 is identical to that of 2025-03-15 and is not repeated. Implemented by the orders in this place (kz-order-91-ghg-regulation-rules, kz-order-221-carbon-trading-rules, kz-order-251-carbon-registry-rules, kz-order-9-ghg-calculation-methods, kz-order-46-inventory-control-rules, kz-order-525-carbon-quota-plan, kz-order-455-carbon-offset-rules, kz-order-190-carbon-cadastre-rules, kz-order-262-carbon-reserve-rules). The first Adilet edition (status new, dated 2021-01-02) is stored as the adopted text under the commencement date 2021-07-01. English: Adilet serves an English page of the whole Code (https://adilet.zan.kz/eng/docs/K2100000400, headed "Unofficial translation", current to the edition of 2026-08-25). It falls under KZ-ADILET-TRANSLATION, permission requested, so it is not stored.
